article.title: Status, challenges, and future directions of machine learning in the management of epilepsy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Chang RS, Nguyen S, Mishra D
article.abstract: Despite advances in epilepsy treatment options, selecting the appropriate therapy for an individual with epilepsy is a process of trial and error. Machine learning holds the potential to support clinical decision making. We aimed to provide an overview of the role of machine learning in epilepsy management and discuss future directions.
